news.title: Giant metal roosters spread autism acceptance in Maine after town zoning spat
news.summary: Giant metal roosters are popping up on lawns in and around a coastal Maine community and as far away as New Zealand in support of a 6-year-old autistic girl and her love of the colorful creations
